title: How should ecommerce brands choose custom corrugated mailer boxes?
buyerQuestion: What should buyers include in a corrugated mailer box RFQ?
legalName: Shenzhen Muge Design Packaging Product Co., Ltd.
sourceCompetitorPatterns: China export-factory competitors tend to use short product-category pages and direct quote prompts for corrugated packaging.
Overseas packaging companies tend to explain ecommerce use cases, shipping route context, sustainability topics and resource-center guidance.
For MUGE, the useful route is to combine product-category clarity with an RFQ checklist for ecommerce mailer structure, protection and print requirements.

decisionDimensions.buyerInputs: Product dimensions, item weight, fragility level, packed quantity and whether the box is for direct shipping, retail handoff or subscription use.
Mailer style, tuck closure, insert or divider requirement, flute direction, board feel and expected packing method.
Inside/outside print direction, color coverage, logo placement, unboxing reference and whether the box must work as both shipper and brand packaging.
Destination market, ecommerce channel, pallet or carton packing notes, sample review purpose and any document questions that require manual confirmation.

rfqChecklist: Product size, product weight and fragility level.
Preferred mailer structure or current shipping box reference.
Protection requirement, insert/divider need and packing route.
Print coverage, logo placement, color direction and finish reference.
Estimated quantity range, target market and ecommerce channel.
Sample review purpose and any destination-document questions for manual review.
